title: Aethra — AI Email & Calendar Workspace
description: An AI-assisted Gmail and Google Calendar workspace that helps you read, triage, search, draft and send email while surfacing calendar context and meeting prep. Risky agent actions pause for human approval.
features: AI triage, TL;DR summaries and reply drafting
Meeting-prep briefs built from calendar and related email
Human-in-the-loop approval for sensitive agent actions
Full-text and vector-style email search
Privacy rules for sensitive senders and domains
Public OpenAPI spec with Scalar API docs

title: VoteZap — Real-Time Polls
description: A production-grade poll platform where creators build anonymous or authenticated polls, watch votes arrive live over WebSockets and publish final results publicly.
features: Live analytics over Socket.IO
Anonymous or sign-in-required response modes
Duplicate-vote prevention with fingerprinting
Dual auth: Google OAuth and my own OIDC provider (PKCE)
Helmet, CORS and rate limiting

title: Custom OIDC Auth Provider
description: My own OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 identity provider. Developers register an app, get a client ID and secret, configure redirect URIs and sign users into their apps with it. VoteZap, 100,000 Checkboxes and the Live Location Tracker log in through it.
features: Authorization Code flow with PKCE
OIDC discovery and JWKS-signed ID tokens
Client ID / secret generation and app registration
Used as the login for several of my other projects

title: Parcha95 Form Builder
description: A modern form builder built as a type-safe monorepo with a tRPC API and a Next.js frontend for creating and managing forms.
features: Form creation and management
End-to-end type safety with tRPC
Monorepo architecture

title: KulhadCSS
description: A utility-first CSS framework with Hindi/Hinglish class names, published on npm. Classes are evaluated at runtime in vanilla JavaScript, so there is no build step.
features: Desi class names like doori-3 and likhai-vazan-bhaari
Dynamic values evaluated from class names
MutationObserver styles new elements automatically
Works with plain HTML and React
